Title: October weather - Autumn 2026 - Xuchang, China
October continues the trend of dropping temperatures as autumn deepens.
Leaves change to hues of orange and red, decorating Xuchang with a spectrum of autumnal shades.
As temperatures continue to calm down from the harsh summer heat, the overall weather remains pleasant, though slightly chillier than the month before.
October comes with a drop in the average high-temperature, falling from September's warm 27°C (80.6°F) to a pleasant 21.7°C (71.1°F).
In the month of October, the nighttime temperature in Xuchang dips to a steady average of 10.5°C (50.9°F).
